headers_that_matter.Set-Cookie: nightlio_token=<JWT>; Expires=<TS>; Max-Age=3600; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax

notes: No Content-Type header and no body at all: request.get_json(silent=True) yields None, treated as {} -- identical response to the empty-JSON-body scenario. The e2e harness (e2e/support/api.js) and the frontend's credential-free auto-login rely on this.
No CSRF headers are required: the request carries no nightlio_token cookie and the endpoint is not behind require_auth.
